question_families.novelty_definition: Report exact boolean membership separately from integer value selection. Present and absent cases with equal returned values must have different presence flags; value-only fallback lookup cannot recover this fact. D1 overlaps practice; family metadata does not grant learner eligibility.

Resolve one alias string in a flat map, then use its retrieved name as the key of a separate integer-score lookup. Missing either required mapping returns caller fallback; an absent alias never implicitly names itself. This dependent two-hop data flow is not supplied by P01/S015 one-map teaching. AI-reviewed family classification never grants learner eligibility.
